state:
Goal `core-serialize-and-1-more`. `Core\Serialize::encode` and `decode` are complete under `bun nv proofs --id`: the class card (off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`), plain-English member cards, one Rust `covers:` test each in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/serialize.rs`, an about, three examples, an attack and a bench each, and two perf records.
`docs/examples/core/Serialize/decode/03-load-saved-jobs-from-a-file.nvs` has its own `[[app]]` block in the root `nvs.toml` for `fs.read`/`fs.write`, in the `Core\Csv` blocks' shape.
The encode attack ends at the memory limit by design (`hostile: ends-early`): one shared string kept 10,000 times in an array is encoded once per copy.
Only `Core\Server::isDraining` is left in this goal.
